title: Prismatic Flow
description: A flow is a sequence of steps within an integration that defines a specific workflow or automation path, including triggers and actions.

description.description: Description of what the flow does

stableKey.description: Stable key used to reference the flow across versions

isSynchronous.description: Whether the flow runs synchronously and returns a response

retryMaxAttempts.description: Maximum number of retry attempts on failure

retryDelayMinutes.description: Delay in minutes between retry attempts

retryUniqueRequestIdField.description: Field used as unique request ID for deduplication

endpointSecurityType.description: Security type for the flow webhook endpoint

steps.description: Ordered list of steps in the flow

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the flow was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the flow was last updated
